spots.name: Spot Road Farm
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 265 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L11510059.

spots.name: Agua Caliente Mountains
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 267 m (876 ft).

spots.name: Glynns Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.

spots.name: O'Neill Pass
spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.
